SELECT
    metadata->>'entidad' AS entidad,
    metadata->>'departamento' AS departamento,
    metadata->>'provincia' AS provincia,
    metadata->>'distrito' AS distrito,
    (metadata->>'entidad_id')::int AS entidad_id,
    (metadata->>'anio')::int AS anio,
    (metadata->>'pia')::numeric AS pia,
    (metadata->>'pim')::numeric AS pim,
    (metadata->>'certificado')::numeric AS certificado,
    (metadata->>'comprometido_anual')::numeric AS comprometido_anual,
    (metadata->>'comprometido')::numeric AS comprometido,
    (metadata->>'devengado')::numeric AS devengado,
    (metadata->>'girado')::numeric AS girado,
    metadata->>'meta_nombre' AS meta,
    metadata->>'programa_ppto_nombre' AS programa,
    metadata->>'especifica_nombre' AS especifica
FROM rag_hecho_presupuesto
WHERE metadata->>'entidad' ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'
  AND ($2::int IS NULL OR (metadata->>'anio')::int = $2)
ORDER BY (metadata->>'anio')::int, especifica;
